title: Truman meeting and the secret Anderson Trust

tellings.quote: They're going to set up this secret uh uh trust they call the Anderson Trust. They set it up down in Houston, Texas.

plain: A researcher, Dan Sheehan, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that in 1945 President Harry Truman met with a circle of senior officials and generals, naming figures such as Douglas MacArthur, Henry Stimson and John J. McCloy. He says they agreed to set up a secret fund called the Anderson Trust, based in Houston, Texas. If true, it would mean a hidden money channel was created at the very top of government, which Sheehan ties to the UFO secret.
